newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle jump, new high set on strong cash.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle jump, new high set on strong cash.

text.p: CME live cattle futures ran up for sharp gains and set a new contract high in February as talk of higher cash cattle sales boosted futures into buy stops, traders said.
February posted a new contract high of 66.475 cents per lb and currently traded 0.750 higher at 66.425 cents. Other months posted gains of 1.025 to 0.425 cents with April up the most at 67.600 cents.
Reports that packers paid up to $65 per cwt added to early support from talk of strong cash markets. Fund buying added to a runup into buy stops, traders said.
